reference_role: Five user-supplied reference screenshots; order dust, dirty dust, clump, shard, crystal; style/category references only, not edit targets
prompt:
Asset: one visual style-study board for five ORIGINAL zinc-processing inventory sprites, arranged left-to-right as clean dust, dirty dust, clump, shard, crystal. The five supplied images are STYLE AND CATEGORY REFERENCES ONLY in that same order, not edit targets. Create fresh silhouettes and new pixel placements; do not repaint, trace, reskin, sample pixels from, reuse or reproduce any supplied sprite or its dark background. The board is a new reference study, not a screenshot.
Goal: fit visually among ordinary tiny ore-processing item sprites, rather than overly polished fantasy art. Each should read as a modest, rough, low-contrast 16x16 logical-pixel sprite shown enlarged with hard square pixels. Shared desaturated zinc/silver gray-green palette with gray-blue shadows and pale gray highlights, thin nuanced contour pixels rather than heavy black outlines. One upper-left light source, broken clusters of 1-2 pixel highlights and medium-gray texture. Keep contrast and occupied size similar to the supplied references. Dust has a compact broad rounded granular mound with a modest peak and uneven low edge, not a triangular cone. Dirty dust is the same material as darker irregular granular mound with only a few dark earthy specks, not big contrasting brown patches. Clump is one solid lumpy elongated oval mass tilted diagonally, with fused planes and streaky pixel lighting, not a cluster of three separate pebbles. Shard is a SHORT crooked jagged angular mineral fragment, brighter on the upper left, chunky across its middle with a broken edge, not a long needle/leaf/knife. Crystal is ONE slender oblique faceted prism leaning up to the right, with stepped sharp edges, bright narrow face and darker broad plane, not a three-pronged crystal cluster. All five remain zinc silver-gray-green even though some reference materials are tan/gold.
Each sprite belongs in its own equal-size tile with clear transparent spacing between sprites. Actual transparent alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no UI, no text, no labels, no colored background, no drop shadow or glow, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients. No metal ingot, no ore blocks. Preserve left-to-right order.
